about: JA4S (ServerHello) and JA4X (certificate) fingerprints of servers that carry tunnels, for xdpi_core/modules/ja4.py. A JA4X row with an issuer pattern names the software alone; other rows need a second sign.

ja4x.seen: Tor relays' link certificates: a random www.<base32>.com issuer and www.<base32>.net subject, common name only, no extensions (three relays, 2026-10-26)
